short_description: MIRAC3 Mid-InfraRed Array Camera filters at 5 K, 25 K or ambient

licence.scope: No licence or reuse statement was found on the CfA-hosted page that serves the curves or on the CfA site pages checked (https://www.cfa.harvard.edu/ footer has only a Mailchimp terms link; /privacy-policy and /terms-use returned 404). The MMT Observatory site footer (https://www.mmto.org/after-your-run/) says 'All rights reserved' but belongs to the telescope's site, not the instrument team's page, so it is not taken as the owner's statement. The MMT credit line is recorded because MIRAC was operated on the MMT (and Magellan). Page cited by SVO: https://www.cfa.harvard.edu/~jhora/mirac/mamajek_index.html. The curves are SVO Filter Profile Service records recovered from Internet Archive captures (svo2.cab.inta-csic.es did not answer on 2026-10-26); SVO states no licence (page footer '© SVO') and asks for the acknowledgement listed in info.json.

acknowledgements.text: Observations reported here were obtained at the MMT Observatory, a joint facility of the Smithsonian Institution and the University of Arizona.
